Higher amounts (5-10 wt%) lead to full coverage of PPE droplets (raspberry morphology), which acts as a barrier layer and decreases CO2 mass uptake.

original_cqs.question: How does the concentration of Janus particles (JPs) affect the CO2 mass uptake in PPE/SAN blends?
original_cqs.expected_answer: CO2 uptake first increases at low concentrations (1 and 2 wt% JPs) due to stress concentration and the formation of microcrazes/cracks that increase available surface area, but then decreases at higher concentrations (5 and 10 wt% JPs) because the PPE phase is fully covered, eliminating stress points and creating a barrier layer via the PB core.
